chunks.text:
Land requirement
- Free of volunteer plants.
- Previous crop not be the same variety or other varieties of the same crop.
- It can be the same variety if it is certified as per the procedures of certification agency.

metadata.source_file: Improved package of practice for Dhaincha (Seed.pdf

chunks.text:
Season
- Rabi and summer are best seasons
- October-November sowing will give better seed yield
- Can be cultivated in kharif with good soil moisture content

metadata.source_file: Improved package of practice for Dhaincha (Seed.pdf

chunks.text:
Isolation distance
- Foundation seed production - 10 m
- Certified seed production - 5 m
- From all sides

metadata.source_file: Improved package of practice for Dhaincha (Seed.pdf

chunks.text:
Seed treatment
- Rhizobium 10 g/kg of seed
- Carbendazim@ 2 g /kg of seeds

metadata.source_file: Improved package of practice for Dhaincha (Seed.pdf

chunks.text:
Seed rate and spacing
- 20 - 30 kg / ha
- Spacing: 60 x 10-20 cm

chunks.text:
Irrigation management
- Three irrigation one each at 3 DAS, at flowering and at pod development stages.
- Controlled flooding irrigation

metadata.source_file: Improved package of practice for Dhaincha (Seed.pdf

chunks.text:
Weed management
- Imazethapyr @0.075 kg a.i. ha -1 at 5 DAS + hand weeding on 15 DAS
- Spray Neem oil 2% to control pod borer

metadata.source_file: Improved package of practice for Dhaincha (Seed.pdf

chunks.text:
Seed grading
- Grade the seeds with BSS 7 x 7 wire mesh sieve

metadata.source_file: Improved package of practice for Dhaincha (Seed.pdf

chunks.text:
Storage
- Store the seeds in gunny or cloth bags for short term storage (8 - 9 months) with a seed moisture content of 9 %
- Store the seeds in 700-gauge polythene bag for long term storage (more than 15 months) with a seed moisture content of 8 %.

chunks.text:
Time of sowing
- Best time for sowing is just after pre-monsoon showers or with good soil moisture it can be grown in all seasons

metadata.source_file: Improved package of practice for Dhaincha (Seed.pdf

chunks.text:
Soil
- Grown in all soil conditions, suitable for medium and lowland soils

metadata.source_file: Improved package of practice for Dhaincha (Seed.pdf

chunks.text:
Seed rate
- 40 kg/ha, seed is broadcasted in soil

chunks.text:
Nutrient management
- Lime application @ 500 kg/ha broadcasted just after incorporation of green manure and before final puddling
- The entire quantity of phosphatic fertilizer (DAP) of the succeeding rice crop can be applied to dhaincha. So that succeeding rice crop gets the N and P from the decomposing green manure.

metadata.source_file: Improved package of practice for Dhaincha (Seed.pdf

chunks.text:
Irrigation
- Irrigation is given once in 15 - 20 days

metadata.source_file: Improved package of practice for Dhaincha (Seed.pdf

chunks.text:
Incorporation of Dhaincha
Time of incorporation: 45-50 DAS or at flower bud stage. It is incorporated with the help of plough and water is impounded for 2-3 days followed by final puddling.
